title: Grid carbon intensity
description: One observation: the carbon intensity of one country's electricity for one period (gCO2e per kWh generated), as a reference dataset publishes it. Voyager use: turning a stay's or an electric vehicle's kWh into CO2e for the trip carbon footprint.

period.description: Length of the period the figure covers.

date.description: First day of the period (YYYY-01-01 for annual figures): the observation time of the series.

intensity_g_per_kwh.description: Grams of CO2e per kWh of electricity generated, exactly as published.

basis.description: `lifecycle` = life-cycle emissions of generation (OWID/Ember); `direct` = combustion only.

publisher.description: Who publishes the figure, and its upstream source (e.g. "Our World in Data, based on Ember and Energy Institute").

dataset.description: The dataset or chart the figure comes from.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
